sections.heading: The first Grandmaster reward
items: A skill at 100 now brings a Grandmaster reward of its own. The first is here; the rest follow over the next updates.
Blacksmith: a Grandmaster smith's weapons and armour carry their mark, like "Steel Sword, forged by Eorlund". The mark stays through wear and repair.
Type /capstone to see your Grandmaster reward, once one of your skills reaches 100.
